name: Voice agents
description: Have one of your voice agents call someone, and start workflows when a call ends or a caller books.

actions.name: Call a phone number
actions.description: Your voice agent calls this number now. The call shows up under Voice agents → Calls when it ends.

inputs.label: Phone number to call
inputs.help: International format, with + and the country code.

inputs.label: Details for the agent
inputs.help: For example customer_name or appointment_time. The agent's texts use them as {{customer_name}}.

inputs.label: Voice agent
inputs.help: Leave empty to run for every agent's calls.

inputs.label: Test payload (JSON)
inputs.help: Use {{ steps.trigger.data.call.summary }}, {{ steps.trigger.data.call.from }}, {{ steps.trigger.data.call.transcript }}, {{ steps.trigger.data.call.data.reason }} (your collected details), {{ steps.trigger.data.call.recording_url }}.

inputs.label: Voice agent
inputs.help: Leave empty to run for every agent's bookings.

inputs.label: Test payload (JSON)
inputs.help: Use {{ steps.trigger.data.booking.name }}, {{ steps.trigger.data.booking.when }}, {{ steps.trigger.data.booking.starts_at }} and ends_at (for calendars), phone, email, service, notes.
